subject: reasoning
question: Rituraj starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards South. He then takes a right turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 12 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only, unless specified)
solution:
Given:

Rituraj starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards South. He then takes a right turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 12 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/317674ed6797c8cd2eba00cba05eb99e62b5fd1b1c80d9e8efb492cceba31bd9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2acab903d91ed5c46028b2533bdaee1a8b59f7c74644899605cd3abe232ef3b3.png] 

Thus, Rituraj has to drive 3km west to reach point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
